Well I have been looking at Kingdom Come Deliverance for a while and I finally jumped and bought it. Now I am not going to go on and on about it being the best game ever. Eastern Europe today is still a mess but it is understandable. The time of the game (AND THE BACKSTORY WHICH THE GAME IS SUPPORTED BY is pivotal. Europe in the early 1400's was a mess. You had the expanding Moslem empire (same as today), the last of the mongol invasions into Europe, the final death of Byzantine Empire, the schism of the Catholic Church (two popes at the same time for crying out loud) the Greek Orthodox Church and finally the beginning of the protestant reformation (the Hussite's). This is all before the formation of the modern European States as we know them. England would under go the War of the Roses, The Scottish Clans were fighting with each other, France was finally coalescing into a modern nation state, Italy wasn't even a dream yet, and every body else were a bunch of glorified bandits preying off of every body else. With all this going on in the background who needs evil mages, or Dragons, (Mankind was doing well enough by it's self thank you).

The other part (SO FAR) I like is the central character (Henry) is really a doofus, who changes and grows over time. There are no hidden POWERS, or ancestral family, or any other such rot. He just try's to live his life as it is and responds to the events that surround him. Yea to the puritans out there there bad language, blood and gore, sexual overtones, lawlessness but that is life weather we like it or not. MANKIND IS NOT NOW, NOR WAS IT EVER, NOR WILL IT EVER BE PERFECT. This is the game as I see it so far.
